title: query descendants
summary: The reverse of query ancestors: lists every class that descends from a given ancestor, across all scanned databases
intro: Read this to answer what derives from this class. It lists every class that descends from a given ancestor across all scanned indexes; derived interfaces are left out on purpose.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint query descendants --of <ancestor> [--db ...] [--json] (the REVERSE of ancestors: every CLASS descending from <ancestor>, across all scanned DBs. Derived INTERFACES are deliberately excluded -- this backs the conversion editor's class pickers. exit 1 = no such ancestor)
help: drag-lint query descendants  --of <ancestor> [--db ...] [--json]   (the REVERSE of ancestors: every CLASS descending from <ancestor>, across all scanned DBs. Derived INTERFACES are deliberately excluded -- this backs the conversion editor's class pickers. exit 1 = no such ancestor)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Descendants of Class...
steps: Needs an index of the project
drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Descendants of Class...
Enter the class; every descending class is listed

questions.ask: Which classes descend from this ancestor?
Can I get them as JSON?
